services.name: Website Development
services.shortDescription: A professional online home that makes your business easy to understand and easy to contact.
services.description: Responsive business websites, clear navigation and purposeful content help customers take the next step.
benefits: A professional online home that makes your business easy to understand and easy to contact.
services.useCases: Business websites, service companies and new ventures.

services.name: Salesforce Development
services.shortDescription: Connect your customer information, sales processes and everyday work with a CRM built around your team.
services.description: We help plan, implement and customize Salesforce to support your business processes and customer relationships.
benefits: Connect your customer information, sales processes and everyday work with a CRM built around your team.
services.useCases: Sales pipelines, customer service and connected business operations.

services.name: App Development
services.shortDescription: Turn a business requirement into a useful mobile experience that your customers and team can rely on.
services.description: We design and develop mobile applications around real user needs, with a considered approach to usability and scalability.
benefits: Turn a business requirement into a useful mobile experience that your customers and team can rely on.
services.useCases: Customer-facing apps, booking experiences and internal tools.

services.name: Digital Marketing
services.shortDescription: Build a more visible digital presence with a focused strategy, relevant content and measurable activity.
services.description: We help identify your audience, choose appropriate channels and plan campaigns that support your business goals.
benefits: Build a more visible digital presence with a focused strategy, relevant content and measurable activity.
services.useCases: Brand awareness, service discovery and lead-generation campaigns.

services.name: Landing Pages
services.shortDescription: Give every campaign a focused destination with a clear message and a simple next step.
services.description: We build dedicated pages that connect your offer, audience and enquiry journey without unnecessary distractions.
benefits: Give every campaign a focused destination with a clear message and a simple next step.
services.useCases: Advertising campaigns, product launches and service promotions.

services.name: Google Business Profile
services.shortDescription: Help nearby customers discover your business and find accurate information when they need it.
services.description: We assist with profile setup and optimization, keeping business details, service information and visual content consistent.
benefits: Help nearby customers discover your business and find accurate information when they need it.
services.useCases: Local shops, professional services and businesses serving a defined area.

services.name: Business Email
services.shortDescription: Make every conversation feel professional with email on your own company domain.
services.description: We help configure domain-based business email and guide your team through account and device setup.
benefits: Make every conversation feel professional with email on your own company domain.
services.useCases: New businesses, growing teams and brands moving beyond personal email.

services.name: Website Maintenance
services.shortDescription: Keep your website current, dependable and ready for the next stage of your business.
services.description: We provide ongoing technical support and agreed maintenance tasks so your website continues to serve your customers.
benefits: Keep your website current, dependable and ready for the next stage of your business.
services.useCases: Existing business websites, regular content changes and ongoing support.

services.name: Lead Capture Forms
services.shortDescription: Make it easier for potential customers to reach you and for your team to manage enquiries.
services.description: We create accessible forms and connect them to the agreed enquiry destination, with useful validation and clear feedback.
benefits: Make it easier for potential customers to reach you and for your team to manage enquiries.
services.useCases: Website enquiries, campaign leads and consultation requests.

services.name: Business Automation
services.shortDescription: Reduce repetitive tasks and keep information moving between your people, tools and processes.
services.description: We map your existing workflows and build practical automations around the tasks that take time away from your core work.
benefits: Reduce repetitive tasks and keep information moving between your people, tools and processes.
services.useCases: Enquiry follow-up, customer onboarding and recurring operational tasks.
